property_summary: After calling fallback with 10 ether when block.number % 15 == 0, the reference contract transfers all balance to msg.sender (c.balance becomes 0) while the buggy contract does not transfer (c.balance remains 10 ether).
change_summary: Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0 to invert the transfer condition.
